description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) RESPONSIVE TACTICS (1 CP) in the OPPONENT's Movement phase — WP-M3a. Fixture sm11e_m3a_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3a_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges: the seven WP-M3a detachments, the Ork player 0 CP, the Warbikers start 12" further left (and, for this one, the unit under test sits on the left). The Ork player's real normal move (BEGIN_NORMAL_MOVE + drag + Confirm) of the Warbikers ends within 8" of the unit; enemy_ended_move opens for the Space Marine player; a REAL click spends 1 CP and the Hellblasters (INFANTRY) rolls a D6 and can make a normal move of up to that many inches; the move is made and the Orks get the phase back.
